sn35.126:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nālandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
sn35.126:1.2: atha kho upāli gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho upāli gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.126:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti?
sn35.126:1.4: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
sn35.126:1.6: ayaṃ kho gahapati hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenamidhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
